watches.name: Summit MK II Après-Bleu
watches.description: Apres Bleu brings a tonal approach to Summit. Deep blue ceramic, a matte blue dial and a matching woven strap carry the colour across the watch, with differences in texture giving each surface its own character. Brushed planes soften the light, while polished edges pick out the case’s contours. The result is a continuous palette that still reveals the construction underneath. After dark, luminous hands and numerals bring a different contrast to the dial. Includes two woven straps: blue and khaki.

watches.name: Summit MK II Glade
watches.description: Glade brings the colours of the forest into Summit: a deep green ceramic case, a pale- green dial and an olive woven strap. The palette moves between shadow and light, pairing a dark outer frame with a fresh, luminous centre. Brushed surfaces soften the green, while polished bevels catch the light along the case’s edges. A pale- green crown accent connects the dial to the profile. After dark, the full dial glows, with contrasting blue- glowing hands giving Glade another expression. Includes two FKM rubber woven straps: green and grey.

watches.name: Summit MK II Dawn Til Dusk
watches.description: From first light to last light, the Summit Dawn Til Dusk MK II captures the warmth of alpine days that stretch into glowing evenings. Built on the refined Summit MK II platform, Dawn Til Dusk pairs a pristine white ceramic case with a fully custom orange-lumed dial developed in-house by Earthen. In daylight, the dial reveals a soft salmon-orange tone. In low light, it comes alive with a warm glow inspired by mountain skies at sunset. The MK II update brings a cleaner inverted 3-6-9 dial layout, deeper multi-layered index printing, dual-sided anti-reflective sapphire crystal, and two color-coordinated FKM rubber straps. It is still unmistakably Summit: compact, ceramic, automatic, and made for real life from mountain mornings to city evenings.

watches.name: Summit MK II Blue Bird
watches.description: A tribute to the perfect day. Crisp air, untouched powder, and endless blue above — the Summit Bluebird captures the essence of skiing’s most coveted conditions. Encased in pristine white ceramic, the watch reflects the brilliance of sunlit slopes, where clarity and contrast define every turn. The all-lume white dial, adorned with ghost-like tone-on-tone markings, echoes the near-invisible landscape, where contrast fades, and only instinct remains. Every detail is designed for clarity amid the elements—minimal, precise, and uncompromising.

watches.description: A world without horizon — where sky and snow blur into one. The Summit Whiteout is a tribute to the raw power of winter’s most extreme conditions. Encased in white ceramic, the watch disappears into its surroundings like a lone skier navigating a silent storm. Inspired by vintage field watches, the black dial grounds the design with quiet confidence — it is balanced, legible, and timeless. Every detail echoes the exhilaration of carving through fresh snow under an open sky.
